creatures.name: Grove Stag

move.name: Bolt
move.effect: Leaves the battle at the end of the round; no damage

weakness.text: It does not fight. Approach while it grazes and it lets you read it.

creatures.lore: A silver-antlered stag of the western groves; its prints glow where the moss is still whole.
creatures.remembrance: It walked the groves at dusk, and the moss stood up where it had passed.

creatures.name: Whisperfox

move.name: Borrowed Voice
move.effect: One pair's next action goes to a random target

weakness.text: Pin it before it speaks: a Slowed fox cannot borrow a voice.

creatures.lore: A small grey fox that speaks with the voices of people it has heard, and no longer knows its own.
creatures.remembrance: It carried the rangers' calls from tree to tree, so no one in the groves was ever lost.

creatures.name: Rootbound Golem

weakness.text: Its roots are grey and brittle where the ichor touched; Track it and strike the grey.

creatures.lore: Roots and stone wound into a walker, its heartwood greyed by the black ichor.
creatures.remembrance: It was the groves' gardener: it carried fallen seed to bare ground and stood guard while it grew.

creatures.name: Stormrider

weakness.text: It rides the confused winds; calm them and it loses its speed.

creatures.lore: A lean winged thing that dives out of the wind faster than the eye.
creatures.remembrance: It ran messages between the sky-cities on the high winds, faster than any sail.

creatures.name: Cloud Serpent

move.name: Coil
move.effect: 10 damage to every pair in one row

weakness.text: It telegraphs each coil one round ahead; read its intent and move the row.

creatures.lore: A long serpent of vapour and scale that wraps a platform before it strikes.
creatures.remembrance: It held the drifting sky-cities together in storms, coiled round their moorings.

creatures.name: Star Moth

weakness.text: It flies to the brightest light on the field; a Veil or Eclipse leaves it lost.

creatures.lore: A wide pale moth whose dust makes a word slip from the tongue.
creatures.remembrance: Galechanters followed its flight at night to find the stars they were singing to.

creatures.name: Crystal Crawler

move.name: Swarm
move.effect: 6 damage per crawler still standing to one pair

weakness.text: Each crawler is weak alone; hit the whole row.

creatures.lore: Many-legged crystal shards that skitter out of the walls in numbers.
creatures.remembrance: They polished the gem veins of the deep cities and made them shine.

creatures.name: Fossil Wurm

move.name: Strike from Below
move.effect: 18 damage; Hidden underground until it strikes

weakness.text: Root it and it cannot burrow.

creatures.lore: A wurm of old bone and new stone that swims through rock.
creatures.remembrance: It carried the memory of the first stones in its bones, and the Stonekeepers sang to it.

creatures.name: Stoneback Behemoth

move.name: Stand Fast
move.effect: Guard +20 to itself and 16 damage to the front row

weakness.text: Its shell turns aside blades; damage that ignores Guard reaches it.

creatures.lore: A great beast with a back of layered rock, set before the Bone Choir.
creatures.remembrance: It was set at the chasm by the first tribes to keep the wyrm bones, and kept them.

creatures.name: Tide Serpent

move.name: Undertow
move.effect: 12 damage and pulls one back-row pair to the front

weakness.text: The corruption sits in its gills like oil; purify it.

creatures.lore: A sea serpent whose scales have gone dull as oil.
creatures.remembrance: It turned the tides in the bays and brought the fish in close to the Tidecaller nets.

creatures.name: Moonfish

weakness.text: It hides behind the others; a pierce or a pull reaches it.

creatures.lore: A round silver fish that swims in the air of the chasm and mends what it touches.
creatures.remembrance: It showed the way home to lost divers by the light of its scales.

creatures.name: Kelprunner

weakness.text: Its kelp is dry and brittle out of the sea; wind tears it.

creatures.lore: A loping thing of knotted kelp that binds whatever it touches.
creatures.remembrance: It tended the kelp forests off the shore, and the young fish hid in them.

creatures.name: Shadehound

move.name: Scent of the Hidden
move.effect: Removes Hidden from one pair; 14 damage to it

weakness.text: It hunts by scent in the dark; light confuses it.

creatures.lore: A long black hound with no eyes, that finds anything hidden by its breath.
creatures.remembrance: The Syndicate kept it to find the lost in the labyrinth and bring them out.

creatures.name: Nightmare

move.name: Dread
move.effect: One pair loses one action next round

weakness.text: Calm and a shared thought steady the pair it frightens.

creatures.lore: A shape of smoke and hooves that comes at the edge of sleep.
creatures.remembrance: It carried dreams through the Underworld, and the Duskbane read them for warnings.

creatures.name: Obsidian Spider

weakness.text: Fire-dark glass cracks under stone; strike it with earth.

creatures.lore: A spider of black glass whose webs catch light and hold it.
creatures.remembrance: It spun the threads the Syndicate followed through the labyrinth, so none went the wrong way twice.

creatures.name: Starborn Owl

weakness.text: It watches the leader; a decoy holds its eye.

creatures.lore: A white owl with stars in its feathers that sees through every shadow.
creatures.remembrance: It kept watch over the Priory's sleepers and woke them when the stars moved.

creatures.name: Luminae

weakness.text: Its light gutters in shadow; darken it and its shields fall.

creatures.lore: Small spirits of light that gather round the crystalline trees.
creatures.remembrance: They lit the crystalline forests at night, so the Priory could read under the trees.

creatures.name: Astral Wyrmling

move.name: Starbreath
move.effect: 16 damage to every pair in one lane

weakness.text: It is young and lonely; a shield it trusts stops its breath.

creatures.lore: A young wyrm of cosmic dust, lost in the Expanse since before it could fly.
creatures.remembrance: It was hatched at #Wrymreach and waited there for a rider it never met.

other_foes.name: Blank-Scribe
other_foes.role: Blanks a bestiary page in the battle, closing Remind

other_foes.name: Hollow
other_foes.role: Slow and hard; gave up the most

other_foes.name: The Unwriter
other_foes.role: Boss: un-names one ability per round; at half Life burns his own Record for a heal

other_foes.name: The Architect's Echo
other_foes.role: Final: Unmake, Press the Veil, Forget a Pair
